name: How long does it usually take to install new bathroom vanity and cabinets?
description: Installation time varies, from one to two days for simple replacements to three to five days or more for complex projects.

mainEntity.name: How long does it usually take to install new bathroom vanity and cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom vanity and cabinet installation varies depending on the project's complexity. A straightforward replacement of an existing vanity can take as little as one to two days. More extensive projects involving custom cabinetry, significant layout changes, or plumbing reconfigurations might require three to five days, or even longer. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project during the initial consultation.
